scope: Coordinate quality in a single deposited asymmetric unit. Model 1, entity 1 and label chains A, B, C. Residue intervals use the label numbering of that deposition. The three pairs share chains.

atom_selections.common_ca: One matched C-alpha atom per common residue.
atom_selections.common_backbone: Equal-weight N, CA, C and O at residues complete in all three chains.
atom_selections.ordered_backbone: Available only for the whole-deposition geometry method: full occupancy and B factor at most 40 in all three chains.

endpoints.angle_deg: Unsigned proper-rotation fit angle in degrees. A signed change compares two such fit angles.
endpoints.rmsd_A: Root-mean-square residual distance after superposition, in angstroms.

parameters.effect_minimum: e, an effect magnitude in endpoint units
parameters.zero_limit: z, 0 < z < e in the same units
parameters.minimum_evaluable: k, a positive integer number of evaluable intervals

signed-summary.json.definition: At least k evaluable intervals and one observed miss: 1. At least k evaluable, all eligible intervals measured and none missed: 0. Otherwise null (missing), with reason and counts. The numerator counts intervals, not independent samples.

outputs.signed-blocks.json: Full-precision fitted values and signed differences for the three pairs and their median, with a label interval, classification and eligibility per row.

methods.classification: For each eligible measured 20-position interval, delta is after omission minus before. Take the three-pair median before and after separately. If every absolute pair change is < e, quiet. Otherwise classify by absolute median change: < z near_zero, [z,e) attenuated, >= e with a pair of opposite sign and magnitude >= e opposed, else represented. near_zero, attenuated and opposed count as misses. Quiet and represented describe this endpoint and sensitivity threshold.

methods.measures: Whole-deposition coverage (matched positions / observed union) and pair fits. A whole-deposition measurement cannot establish a local interval effect.
Fit all three pairs before and after omitting each eligible 20-position interval. The table includes dispersed-deletion controls and the values from which signed differences can be calculated.

parameters.block_index: Zero-based label interval index. Index 0 denotes 1–20.

methods.measures: Extracts one interval/pair from an existing block-influence.json table, both endpoints and matched controls. The cell shares the original computation and deposited coordinates.

interpretation: Compare an interval within the same deposition and endpoint when checking atom-selection sensitivity. Histories and admission/coverage counts are descriptive. Sampling independence is unknown. Report missingness and assessable denominators.
